snippet.title: WALL-E (video game) - FULL GAME walkthrough | Longplay
snippet.description:
WALL-E is an adventure video game base on the animated movie of the same name, developed by Asobo Studio and published by THQ in 2008. The game follows the storyline of the movie, featuring the titular character WALL-E, a small waste-collecting robot, as he embarks on an adventure that takes him from Earth to the Axiom spaceship.
